LIFEPAK CR2 automated external defibrillator (AED)

Get connected, stay ready

The LIFEPAK CR2 AED response system empowers bystanders to help save lives. Innovative, easy-to-operate technology allows continuous CPR and helps streamline communication across the system of care.

text.text:
Stay ready with connected 4G cellular AEDs

The benefits of a connected AED are clear:

  • Simple connection process
  • Automatic daily self-tests, software updates and status notifications
  • Wireless monitoring to locate and track AEDs
  • Key event data can be transferred from lay responders to professionals
  • Enables connection in outdoor areas

High-quality CPR with a shorter time to first shock

The intuitive design and clear graphics allow users to deliver a first shock 24 to 35 seconds faster than the Philips OnSite AED and ZOLL AED Plus.1

text_copy.text:
cprINSIGHT

Compared to a conventional AED, it reduces pre-shock pause and increases chest-compression fraction.*2

Transmit data

Send information to arriving first responders with LIFENETCentral AED program manager.

Powerful escalating energy 

Capable of delivering 360 J shocks.

text.text: LIFEPAK CR2 AED FAQs

text_copy.text: The LIFEPAK CR2 lithium battery provides approximately 800 minutes of "ON" time or 166 discharges at 200 joules. If installed within a year from the manufacturing date, its standby life is 4 years.
LIFEPAK CR2 comes with one set of QUIK-STEP pacing/ECG/defibrillation electrodes, one lithium battery and a USB cable.

text.text: The CHILD MODE button switches the defibrillator to deliver reduced energy levels appropriate for children and adjusts CPR coaching prompts. It can be activated for patients between one and eight years old or weighing less than 25 kg (55 lbs). Pressing it again switches back to ADULT MODE.

text_copy.text: Adults: 200 joules (first shock), 300 joules (second shock), and 360 joules (third and subsequent shocks). Users can configure energy levels selecting values from 150 to 360J. Children: 50 joules (first shock), 75 joules (second shock), and 90 joules (third and subsequent shocks). Users can configure energy levels selecting values from 35 to 90J.

LIFEPAK CR2 gives clear CPR instructions through cprCOACH Feedback Technology, which provides metronome tones at the correct compression rate and adjusts voice prompts as needed to guide responders. In addition, LIFEPAK CR2 is also able to automatically adjust the volume of the voice prompts based on the ambient noise.
